title: How Much You’d Earn If You Bought Property in 10 Major Cities 10 Years Ago
summary: Bought real estate in 2015? You probably did pretty well. Home prices in cities like Austin and Miami have more than doubled since then. Even slower markets like Chicago and New York still saw solid gains.
